digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Thursday, September 3, with nine active calendar blocks, five urgent items, nine carried-over tasks, and no active reminders. Use the noon Amazon Connect sync to turn the completed Round 1 close into a firm Round 2 readiness plan, use the 11:00 AM Toggl touchpoint to settle capacity-reporting expectations, and close the remaining migration and Sprint 17 ownership gaps before the meeting-heavy afternoon. The main risk is that UAT scripts are only 90% complete for Tuesday's kickoff while first-line technical support and a dedicated Salesforce integration account still need confirmed ownership. Dashboard state was last modified Friday, August 28, so completion status may not reflect more recent work.

items.label: Lock the Amazon Connect Round 2 readiness plan
items.detail: Round 1 is officially closed, the 26 testers are organized into four groups, and two UAT champions are identified. At today's project sync, confirm the remaining high-concern scripts, finish the Round 2 scripts due Friday, name first-line technical support, and decide how to route the dedicated Salesforce integration account before Tuesday's kickoff.

items.label: Close the remaining Amazon Connect migration-list gaps
items.detail: Finalize the production list, provisioning guidance, and alternate caller IDs. About 150 users have fax-linked direct numbers that may still require RingCentral, so document the interim scope and owner before Round 2.

items.label: Prioritize Licelot's Quality project portfolio
items.detail: Rank the five Quality requests by business impact and set one intake path that fits available PM and PE capacity.

items.label: Update the Sprint plan with the agreed DNC direction
items.detail: Record Biographical Deadlines as deferred and NTA as included, then place the DNC automation-removal request in the Sprint 18 path with Ben as main contact and tester.

items.label: Confirm the August hours report is closed with Sara
items.detail: Sara thanked the team for the hours and calculated utilization after PTO and holidays were included. Verify that no final delivery remains, then close the task in the dashboard.

items.label: Limpiar Asana con el spreadsheet de Armando
items.detail: Use the 11:30 AM Armando 1:1 to reconcile the spreadsheet against Asana, close stale entries, and leave one current operating view.

items.label: Decide Eduanny Suero's SOP access request
items.detail: Confirm the business need and permission level for the Travel Permit client-contact SOP, then approve or decline the outstanding SharePoint request.

items.label: Clear the stalled Sales and Revenue Cloud dependencies
items.detail: Confirm the Revenue Cloud owner, bring Deepak and Tim into the Sales Cloud work, secure an invoice record in sandbox, and set firm due dates.

items.label: Close out the Staff Aug document question
items.detail: Confirm that Licelot has the intended access path and knows whether any action remains after the accidental broad sharing invitation.

items.label: 10:30 AM-noon - Standup, Toggl touchpoint, and Armando 1:1
items.detail: Three back-to-back meetings leave no transition time. Bring the UAT closeout to standup, settle time-tracking guidance at 11:00 AM, and use the Armando 1:1 to close the Asana reconciliation.

items.label: Noon-2:00 PM - Amazon Connect sync and protected follow-through
items.detail: Use the project sync to assign Round 2 readiness owners, then protect the 90-minute block for migration, Sprint, and reporting follow-through.

items.label: 2:00-4:00 PM - Firmwide meeting followed by Laura and Thiago 1:1s
items.detail: The afternoon starts a continuous three-hour meeting run. Use Laura's 1:1 for the client-notification scope and Thiago's for Round 2 readiness and support ownership.

items.label: 4:00-5:00 PM - Tudo Bem weekly meeting
items.detail: Bring the team's concerns about unclear capacity measurement, missing process owners, and PM staffing into the weekly operating discussion.

items.label: Clarify the Toggl capacity model and escalation path
items.detail: At the 11:00 AM touchpoint, explain how utilized and non-utilized time will inform capacity, name the owner for missing project IDs, and tell the team how the data will support staffing decisions.

items.label: Decide the broader client-notification SOP path
items.detail: Lucia said the trigger extends beyond SMS to phone, business-development, attorney, website, email, and social responses, and asked whether the work belongs in BCP. Align with Laura, decide the project home and owner, and reply with the next step.

items.label: Jenn Gold is out today
items.detail: Ashley Saunders is covering for SaltClick; route any Amazon Connect follow-up that cannot wait through Ashley.

items.label: 10:30-11:00 AM - Salesforce Program Standup conflicts with SVC standup
items.detail: Choose coverage in advance and make sure the Amazon Connect readiness update reaches both groups.

items.label: 11:30 AM-1:00 PM - Protected focus block before EPMO EOW
items.detail: Use the uninterrupted window to finish the weekly executive update and close any owners left open today.

items.label: 1:00-3:30 PM - EPMO EOW, self-review training, pipeline sync, and slide update
items.detail: The 2:00 PM training overlaps the 2:30 PM project-pipeline sync; attend only if a prior mandatory training was missed, and protect the 3:00 PM executive slide update.
